facts.fact: 甜夜次日：走廊挤满邻居与陌生人（激动/失神/晃动如水流），楼下同样聚集——她恐慌：是我毁了两界平衡？
facts.anchor: bodies swaying slightly as if caught in a current

facts.fact: 对质：他从办公室那次就知情却隐瞒（不想给她负担）；「So you lied to me.」「I omitted——有区别。」「对我来说没有。」
facts.anchor: I omitted,” he responds, gentle in his deliverance.

facts.fact: 她的自责接管：「等他走了再跳就没事了」；「And it's my fault. What isn't, at this point?」
facts.anchor: I should have waited until he was gone to jump.

facts.fact: 他反击：你来之前就在死——慢慢褪色；「is that what you want to return to?」；她反击「你在改动世界」；他爆发「我要看你再笑」——她喊「I never asked for any of that!」他平静：「You didn't ask for it, but it's what you are, nonetheless.」
facts.anchor: You were dying before I showed up

facts.fact: 逐出令：No more visits / no more flowers / For good.——他问「Is that truly what you want?」她心里尖叫 No，援引神父规则逼自己 mean it：「That's what I want.」
他遵守条款：不进梦、不现身、留她过自己选的生活——「I will respect it and leave, Maven Talmay.」
facts.anchor: I will not visit your dreams.

facts.fact: 退路反转：「即使你改变心意、像我渴你那样渴我——我也不会回来。但呼唤，我听得见。」
facts.anchor: Though I will hear if you call for me.

facts.fact: 群众散去、危机解除——「为什么感觉像犯了此生最大的错」；她穿他的衬衫卷在地板喊「Go and don't come back!」——回答只有自己声音的碎回声。
facts.anchor: the shattered echo of my own voice
